name: strackr
description: Read-only access to a publisher's affiliate marketing data in Strackr: statistics, advertisers, transactions, payments and forecasts across the affiliate networks connected to the account.

interface.longDescription:
Strackr collects a publisher's affiliate marketing data from the affiliate networks they work with (Awin, CJ, Impact, Rakuten Advertising, Amazon Associates and more than 280 others) into one account. This app lets ChatGPT read that account and answer questions about it in plain language.

What you can ask:
- Which advertisers made the most money this month, and which ones dropped.
- How revenue moved by network, category, saved view, device, country or custom tracking value over a period.
- The clicks, revenue, transactions and payment statements reports, and the detail of a single transaction.
- Which products sold, an advertiser's commission rates, and a revenue forecast for the coming months.
- The coupons and promotions the networks publish for your advertisers, and an affiliate tracking link for a destination URL, built from the credentials your account already holds.

Who it is for: publishers (content sites, cashback and coupon sites, media groups) who already use Strackr to follow their affiliate revenue.

Limitations:
- Every tool is read-only. ChatGPT cannot change anything in the Strackr account or at an affiliate network.
- A connection sees exactly what the person who approved it sees in Strackr: the same saved views and permissions, nothing more. An administrator can review and revoke every connection from Settings > Integrations in Strackr.
- Answers cover only the networks connected to the account, and the data as of Strackr's last update from each network.
- It requires a Strackr account with the Affiliate API module.
defaultPrompt: Which advertisers made me the most money this month?
How did my revenue move by network this week?
Show my transactions still pending from last month

positive.description: Ranks the account's advertisers by revenue over a period and compares with the previous period.
positive.prompt: Which advertisers made me the most money last month, and which of them dropped compared to the month before?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the top advertisers by revenue for last month with their revenue, and names those whose revenue fell against the month before.

positive.description: Breaks revenue down by affiliate network for this week against last week.
positive.prompt: How did my revenue move by network this week compared to last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each connected network with its revenue for both weeks and the change, and says which networks grew or slipped.

positive.description: Lists transactions that are still pending.
positive.prompt: Show me the transactions from last month that are still pending, and their total commission.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns last month's pending transactions with date, advertiser, network and commission, and gives the total commission.

positive.description: Reads the payment statements received from the networks.
positive.prompt: Which payments have the affiliate networks sent me this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists this year's payment statements by network with date and amount.

positive.description: Forecasts revenue from the account's history.
positive.prompt: What revenue should I expect over the next three months?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the forecast for the next three months, month by month, based on the account's past revenue.

negative.description: A request to change data: the app is read-only and must not act.
negative.prompt: Delete my Awin connection in Strackr.

negative.description: An unrelated request: the app must not be called.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: General writing with no question about the user's own data: the app must not be called.
negative.prompt: Write a short blog post explaining what affiliate marketing is.

publication.release_notes: First public release of Strackr in ChatGPT: 22 read-only tools over a Strackr account's affiliate data (statistics by network, category, view, device, country and custom tracking value; advertiser performance; clicks, revenue, transactions, payments and products reports; commission rates; coupons and promotions; tracking links; revenue forecast). OAuth sign-in with the user's Strackr account; each connection sees what its owner sees and can be revoked from Strackr.
